metadata.notes: These are starting assumptions inherited from the prototype, not vendor quotes or measured site data. Replace and document every relevant value.

economics.source_notes: Unknown values must remain null. The optimizer enables annualized_lifecycle_cost_per_year only when every required cost input is supplied, the CSV covers a complete calendar year, and backup power is disabled. This is a first-pass estimate, not a bankable techno-economic assessment; see docs/PARAMETER_CONFIGURATION.md.

parameter_sources.default_policy: For each overridden value, record source type, source/reference, date, and uncertainty in your project notes. Do not label assumed values as measured.
